Overview

Calabar is a city in Cross River with a population of 520,000. A historic port city in southeastern Nigeria, known for its colonial architecture, annual carnival, and tourism. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
